alert: Actovia's knowledge base is optional and powered by a self-hosted LightRAG server that you run — Actovia only connects to it, pushing your documents and asking for relevant context; it never runs, upgrades, or manages LightRAG itself. Leave the URL empty to keep the knowledge base disabled. Retrieval is context-only: LightRAG finds relevant passages, but your configured chat model always writes the answer. The embedding model is locked once you ingest a document — changing it later requires wiping LightRAG's storage and re-adding every document, so pick one you'll keep.
